changelog.title: Milestone 4: custom wake-name onboarding
items: Added Polish name suitability scoring, generated confusable phrases and a guided desktop recording wizard.
Added deterministic local ONNX training, cancellable jobs, wake-only validation and sensitivity selection.
Added atomic model activation, previous-model preservation and safe cleanup for retraining.
Kept first-run microphone capture disabled until a validated wake model is active.

changelog.title: Milestone 3: Polish voice pipeline
items: Added bounded RAM-only microphone capture, temporary openWakeWord activation and Silero speech boundaries.
Added forced-Polish faster-whisper transcription, deterministic processing and cancellable Piper playback.
Added follow-up listening, stale-operation suppression and safe audio shutdown/retry behavior.
Protected voice traffic with a per-launch Tauri/core credential and Protocol 1.1 events.

changelog.title: Milestone 2 architecture review
items: Added bounded reconnect and heartbeat handling for late starts and core restarts.
Added correlated state snapshots and stale-session protection.
Hardened localhost, malformed-message and multi-client behavior.
Unified JSON Schema, Python and TypeScript validation with a shared contract corpus.

changelog.title: Milestone 2: local core and protocol
items: Added a localhost-only Python 3.12 FastAPI core with health and WebSocket handshake.
Added protocol-v1 contracts for health, assistant states and safe error handling.
Connected the desktop overlay to core health and graceful disconnected states.
Added deterministic state, protocol and provider-interface tests.

changelog.title: Milestone 1: desktop shell
items: Built the Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript desktop application.
Added a frameless always-on-top overlay with compact, chat and settings modes.
Added tray integration, a global fallback shortcut and simulated Polish assistant states.
Added frontend quality checks and state-transition tests.

changelog.title: Project foundation defined
items: Defined Polish-only local-first V1 architecture.
Added custom assistant-name and guided wake-word training design.
Selected initial Tauri/React + Python/FastAPI architecture.
Defined Qwen3.5 model tiers, Polish voice pipeline and screen-awareness strategy.
Added typed tool and permission model.
Created Codex-ready source-of-truth documentation structure.
Added development-status website and Pages workflow.
